t: Section 106(k)(1)(F) of title 49, United States Code, is amended to read as follows:“(F) $9,350,028,000 for fiscal year 2010.”.

fable.w: This section only amends an authorization-of-appropriations figure for fiscal year 2010 in title 49. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation amendment that sets a specific dollar amount for a fiscal year. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, public comment, or advisory process with parties outside the federal government. It is purely a budgetary provision.
